tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gtor bsngos nyung ngu phrin las kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so//

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ 'khor 'das gnyis bsdus gzung 'dzin dngos po'i chos// dmigs med stong pa'i ngang las rlung me dang*// thod pa'i khri steng ka pā la yi nang*// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la rang rang gi| |sa bon gyis mtshan rlung g.yos me sbar bas// rdzas khol nyes pa kun bral bcud dang ldan// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// gtor mgron 'khor bcas spyan drangs so so'i ljags// rdo rje'i sbug can thod pa'i bdud rtsi la// reg pa tsam gyis dgyes pa bskyed gyur cig /gtor ma bdud rtsi'i longs spyod dam pa ni// rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum| |'dul mngon mdo sde'i bka' bab chu bo bzhi// bshad sgrub dbang khrid lung dang man ngag gi// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du kha raṃ khā hi/ *// dus kyi 'khor lo bde dgyes gsang ba 'dus// sgrub pa bka' brgyad 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// gsang sngags gsar rnying bka' gter man ngag gi// yi dam lha tshogs zhal du kha raṃ khā hi// ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi yab yum 'khor// a phyi chos sgron tshe ring brtan ma'i tshogs// smug nag sde gsum gza' klu ha ra dang*// kun dga' gzhon nu gza' mchog rā hu la// pe har gnod sbyin rtsi dmar la sogs pa'i// chos skyong srung ma'i zhal du kha raṃ khā hi// gzhan yang phyogs skyong zhing skyong lha klu sogs// dpal mgon bdun cu gnas yul mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// yul lha gzhi bdag 'go ba'i lha lnga sogs// mgon skyabs srung ma'i zhal du kha raṃ khā hi// 'gro ba rigs drug sde brgyad 'byung po dang*// gzhan gyi rigs sngags rbad 'dre gnod byed bgegs// lan chags bu lon la sogs snying rje'i mgron// gang yin gtor mas tshims shing bde thob nas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub dam pa thob gyur cig

/de ltar bla ma yi dam chos srung la// dam rdzas gtor ma'i dgyes mchod phul ba'i mthus// mchog thun dngos grub dam pa myur thob cing*// don gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas sa thob shog /de ma thob kyang tshe rabs thams cad du// mi mthun nad gdon bar gcod zhi ba dang*// tshe dpal longs spyod dpal 'byor kun rgyas shing*// bsam don 'bad med chos bzhin 'grub gyur cig /bla ma yi dam dgyes pa bskyed pa dang*// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs rgyud bskul ba dang*// chos skyong srung ma'i thugs dam bskang ba dang*// dam tshig nyams chags ma lus sor chud nas// mthun phyogs bkra shis dge legs rgyas gyur cig /mgron rnams so so'i gnas su gshegs nas kyang*| |gang tshe spyan 'dren slar yang 'byon par gsol// dge 'dis 'gro rnams 'khor ba las grol nas// rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa dang*// bdag kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gyur cig /ces pa'ang dbon po ra stags pa dkon mchog rtse mos gtor bsngos nyung ngu zhig dgos gsungs par/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong gnas lnga smra ba rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas nye ba'i 'thung spyod dpal tsā ri tra'i pho brang chen po g.yu+u mtshor bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ//
